records.title: Agency DTDs, stylesheets and the STF DTD are still not vendored, so no package is ever DTD-validated (the FDA region-conformance over-claim is gone)
records.evidenceAtHead: At 94b4f9238, `git ls-files | grep -iE '[.](dtd|xsl)$'` returns nothing. assets/ectd-dtd/ holds only README.md, checksums.txt (every manifest entry is still a commented '# <sha256>' placeholder, lines 44-50) and fixtures/index-{valid,invalid}.xml. `git log 92ccdba1..HEAD -- assets/ectd-dtd` shows only b434c39e3, which fixed the fixture's xlink namespace. server/services/ectd/dtd-bundler.ts:85-111 (REGIONAL_DTD, requiredDtdsForRegion) still names no STF DTD. The packager only checks that DTD files are present: regional-packager.ts:1246-1278 calls assessDtdReadiness, which is report-only unless ECTD_REQUIRE_DTD=true in production. It never runs xmllint --valid. The only DTD validation is in the qualification harness (server/services/ectd/qualification/qualify.ts:286-311, validateBackboneFile). That harness checks only index.xml and the regional backbone (:429, :435), returns `dtdSkipped` when the DTD is absent, and never checks STF files. Every compile reports the gap: server/routes/ectd-compile.ts:1176-1180 pushes 'The package references eCTD DTDs that are not bundled under util/dtd/ — it is not self-contained'. FIXED PART: at 92ccdba1, regional-backbone-readiness.ts had CONFORMANT_REGIONS={'fda'} and returned regionConformant:true for the region alone. At HEAD, classifyRegionalBackbone (server/services/ectd/regional-backbone-readiness.ts:117-135) returns true only when fdaBackboneGaps (regional-packager.ts:465-474) is empty. fdaContactGaps (:477-489) always yields at least one gap: either no contact, or a phone with no telephone-number-type. So FDA is never reported conformant. regionConformant is still not derived from any DTD validation.
records.fixedBy: 8f1c2ba5f (2026-10-01): server/services/ectd/regional-backbone-readiness.ts:117-135 and server/services/submission-gateways/regional-packager.ts:1416-1421. regionConformant now comes from the builder's reported gaps, so FDA is no longer conformant by region alone.
records.remaining: (1) These files are not vendored or checksummed: ICH ich-ectd-3-2.dtd and ectd-2-0.xsl; FDA us-regional-v3-3.dtd and us-regional.xsl; ICH STF ich-stf-v2-2.dtd; and the FDA Module 1 valid-values file. (2) No xmllint --valid runs in assemble, compile or transmit. The qualification harness skips DTD validation when the DTD is absent and never checks STF files. (3) regionConformant comes from the builder's own report, not from a passing DTD validation. (4) The STF DTD is not in requiredDtdsForRegion, so the self-containment check ignores it. (5) The gate defaults stay report-only; this is tracked as CAT2-08.
records.severityRationale: FDA validates every backbone against the agency DTDs and technically rejects invalid ones. With no DTD in the repo, nobody can know whether a pilot sequence would be accepted, and CAT2-02/03/04 show it would not be. The files are public agency downloads, so acquiring them is cheap. That is the precondition for fixing and proving CAT2-02 to CAT2-04, so this stays P0 for an FDA eCTD pilot.
records.humanTestingNote: Every eCTD Compile result in Submission Center is 'not submission-ready' with the blocker 'The package references eCTD DTDs that are not bundled under util/dtd/ — it is not self-contained. Vendor the ICH/regional DTDs before transmission.' The zip still builds and downloads. Workaround: treat the message as expected. On staging, pointing ECTD_DTD_DIR at a folder holding the official DTD and XSL files clears the message, but it does not prove the XML is valid. DTD validity is not visible anywhere in the product.
records.acceptance:
1. `git ls-files assets/ectd-dtd` lists ich-ectd-3-2.dtd, ectd-2-0.xsl, us-regional-v3-3.dtd, us-regional.xsl and ich-stf-v2-2.dtd. `cd assets/ectd-dtd && grep -v '^#' checksums.txt | grep . | sha256sum -c` passes, and changing one byte in a temp copy makes verifyChecksumManifest fail.
2. Failing first: before the backbone fixes, the new test shows `xmllint --valid` failing on the golden FDA package's us-regional.xml, index.xml and STF files, and the production packager throwing. fixtures/index-invalid.xml is rejected.
3. A production packaging run with xmllint removed from PATH refuses, instead of reporting ran:false and continuing.
4. bundle.regionalBackbone.regionConformant is true only for a package whose regional backbone passed DTD validation and whose builder gaps are empty. A unit test covers both outcomes.
5. `npm run qualify:ectd` emits 'xmllint DTD' rows, with no dtdSkipped, for index.xml, m1/us/us-regional.xml and every STF, and goes green once CAT2-02/03/04 land.
6. An FDA compile in eCTD Compile no longer shows the 'not self-contained' blocker.
records.dependencies: This is the root finding; nothing upstream. It blocks verification of CAT2-02, CAT2-03 and CAT2-04. CAT2-08 should flip ECTD_REQUIRE_DTD only after this lands. Fetching the files needs a machine with network access, because the build environment's egress policy blocks fda.gov and ich.org.

records.title: FDA us-regional.xml: applicant name, id element, contact wrappers, application-containing-files and heading order are fixed; the sequence path still writes a placeholder DUNS, no contacts, untyped phones, flat Module 1 headings and forms in the wrong place
records.evidenceAtHead:
Fixed in server/services/submission-gateways/regional-packager.ts:
- fdaApplicantInfoBlock (:387-395) writes <id> and <company-name> from sponsorId and sponsorName;
- fdaApplicantContact (:406-417) wraps <telephones><telephone> and <emails><email>;
- buildFdaBackbone writes <application application-containing-files='true'> (:632);
- fdaModule1Block (:441-458) sorts headings by section.
Still open:
(a) The canonical sequence path never records a DUNS. ectd-compile.ts:1047 passes sponsorId `UNASSIGNED-ORG-${orgId}`. transmitSequence (submission-service.ts:2185) and the export path (assemble-from-core.ts:655) default to it, and AnaToolExecutor.ts:9211 hardcodes it. The package-identity.ts header says 'The applicant's <id> (D-U-N-S) has no recorded home on the sequence path yet'. Nothing refuses it at assemble.
(b) core-to-packager.ts:349-357 builds the fda block with no contacts and no forms. On that path <applicant-contacts> is omitted (:388-390) and 1.1 form leaves have no form type.
(c) <telephone> never carries telephone-number-type. fdaContactGaps (:477-489) says the FDA code list is not vendored.
(d) Every Module 1 heading is still written flat under <m1-regional> (server/services/ectd/controlled-vocab/fda-regional-sections.ts:92-116, usRegionalHeadingPlacement). Element names are still derived from v4.0 context-of-use descriptions (fda-regional-sections.ts:1-36).
(e) <form form-type> is still nested in <submission-information> (:420-430, :641). fdaFormGaps calls form placement 'an open question'.
(f) There is no DTD to validate against (CAT2-01).
Only the package path records DUNS and contact and refuses with REGULATORY-IDENTIFIER-MISSING when they are missing: Gateway Transmittals, using PUT /api/submission-ops/packages/:id/regulatory-identifiers (submission-ops.ts:2258) and the assemble step at submission-ops.ts:2944-3004.
records.fixedBy: 8f1c2ba5f (2026-10-01): server/services/submission-gateways/regional-packager.ts:376-489 and :632; server/services/ectd/controlled-vocab/fda-regional-sections.ts:56-116. cea1f4450: server/services/ectd/regulatory-identifiers.ts:180-281 (FDA application-number, DUNS and contact rules) and server/routes/submission-ops.ts:2944-3004 (package path only).
records.remaining: (1) On the canonical sequence path (eCTD Compile, freeze/dispatch, transmitSequence, export, AnA) the DUNS is always the placeholder `UNASSIGNED-ORG-<orgId>`, and nothing refuses it. (2) No regulatory contact reaches the packager on that path, so <applicant-contacts> is omitted. (3) <telephone> has no telephone-number-type. (4) Nested Module 1 headings (1.3.x, 1.12.x, 1.14.x and others) are written flat under <m1-regional>, with element names derived from the v4 context-of-use list instead of the v3.3 DTD. (5) <form> sits in <submission-information>, and 1.1 form leaves get no form-type on the canonical path. (6) us-regional.xml has never been checked against the DTD.
records.severityRationale: A us-regional.xml with 'UNASSIGNED-ORG-n' as the D-U-N-S number, no applicant contacts, untyped telephones and flattened Module 1 headings is very likely DTD-invalid, and it misidentifies the applicant. FDA would technically reject the sequence. That is the core FDA filing journey for the pilot.
records.humanTestingNote: In eCTD Compile, the regional backbone shown for an FDA sequence reads <id>UNASSIGNED-ORG-<org id></id> and has no <applicant-contacts>. No field on the project or the sequence records the D-U-N-S number or the regulatory contact. Compile still produces a zip. Workaround: none on the sequence path. For packages assembled in Gateway Transmittals, the 'Regulatory identifiers' form there does record the DUNS and contact.
records.acceptance:
1. Failing first: the new test fails at HEAD with xmllint errors on us-regional.xml, and passes after the fix.
2. An eCTD Compile of an FDA sequence whose project has no D-U-N-S number or no regulatory contact fails with PACKAGE_IDENTITY_MISSING, naming applicantId or contact. With them recorded, us-regional.xml contains <id>123456789</id> and an <applicant-contacts> block whose <telephone> carries a valid telephone-number-type.
3. `grep -rn 'UNASSIGNED-ORG-' server --include=*.ts` returns only package-identity.ts (dry run) and tests.
4. A package with leaves at 1.3.1.1 and 1.14.4.1 nests them inside their DTD parent elements.
5. bundle.regionalBackbone.regionConformant is true for the golden fixture, and false if the contact is removed.
6. ci:migration-set-order and ci:migration-drop-safety pass.
records.dependencies: CAT2-01 (vendored us-regional-v3-3.dtd and the FDA valid-values file, plus the DTD-validation hook in the packager). The founder must get the pilot customer's D-U-N-S number and regulatory contact. Shares the package-identity plumbing with the CAT2-07/08 work.

records.title: ICH index.xml heading tree is still truncated, with no substance, manufacturer, product, dosage-form or indication attributes, no node-extension and non-ICH folder names
records.remaining: All of the finding. The heading tree is truncated in Modules 2, 3, 4 and 5. The repeatable-section attributes (substance, manufacturer, product-name, dosageform, indication) required on m2-3-s, m2-3-p, m3-2-s, m3-2-p, m3-2-a and m5-3-5 are neither modelled nor emitted. There is no node-extension. Folder names are not ICH folder names. The wrong 'no m3-2-s-4 element' comment remains. index.xml has never been DTD-validated (CAT2-01).
records.severityRationale: A missing #REQUIRED attribute on m3-2-s, m3-2-p or m5-3-5 makes index.xml DTD-invalid, which FDA technically rejects. Leaves filed under a parent heading are also misfiled in the reviewer's tree. Every IND or NDA with Module 3 content hits this.
records.humanTestingNote: A click-through tester will not see this, because compile succeeds. A regulatory tester who reads index.xml in eCTD Compile, or runs an external validator on the downloaded zip, will see 3.2.S and 3.2.P leaves filed directly under the drug-substance or drug-product heading with no substance or manufacturer, and 5.3.5.x reports with no indication. No in-product workaround.
records.acceptance:
1. Failing first: `xmllint --valid index.xml` on the golden FDA package fails at HEAD, reporting missing required attributes or elements on m3-2-s-drug-substance, m3-2-p-drug-product and m5-3-5, and passes after the fix.
2. A 3.2.S.4.1 leaf appears under m3-2-s-drug-substance[substance, manufacturer] > m3-2-s-4-control-of-drug-substance > m3-2-s-4-1-specification.
3. Placing a 3.2.S leaf without a substance returns 400 from PUT /api/submissions/sequences/:seqId/leaves, and packaging such a leaf throws a ValidationError.
4. Changing one byte of the vendored DTD makes the generated-table drift test fail.
5. The golden package's folders follow the ICH folder names.
6. ci:migration-set-order and ci:migration-drop-safety pass.
records.dependencies: CAT2-01 (the vendored ICH DTD and the DTD-validation hook). Shares the leaf-metadata plumbing (UpsertLeafInput, placement dialogs) with CAT2-04. Product data for the substance, manufacturer and dosage form must be supplied by the pilot customer.

records.title: STF rewritten to the study-identifier / doc-content→index.xml#ID shape, but its DOCTYPE cannot resolve, its DTD is neither shipped nor validated, and the new 1789 gate blocks FDA sequences with study reports because the UI cannot record a study id or file-tag
records.evidenceAtHead:
Fixed by 6becd3fda (2026-10-05). server/services/ectd/stf-generator.ts:220-243 now emits <ectd:study dtd-version='2.2'><study-identifier><title/><study-id/></study-identifier><study-document><doc-content xlink:href='<rel>/index.xml#<leaf ID>'><title/><file-tag name info-type='ich'/></doc-content></study-document>. Files are named stf-<study-id>.xml (:168-178), and dataset/define.xml tags outside the TRC 1735 list are refused (:192-218). Packager wiring is at regional-packager.ts:1114-1186. Running generateStfFiles at HEAD via `npx tsx -e` confirmed this output.
Still open:
(a) The DOCTYPE is still `SYSTEM 'ich-stf-v2-2.dtd'` (:232). It resolves relative to the study folder (e.g. m5/5-3-5-1/study-101/), which holds no DTD, and no relative util/dtd path is computed.
(b) xmlns:xlink is hardcoded to http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink (:233), while the backbones use ECTD_XLINK_NS = http://www.w3c.org/1999/xlink (ich-headings.ts:50). The b434c39e3 commit message says the STF generator was deliberately left unchanged.
(c) The STF DTD is neither vendored nor in requiredDtdsForRegion (dtd-bundler.ts:108-111). qualify.ts validates only index.xml and the regional backbone (:429, :435), so no STF is ever DTD-checked.
(d) No <category> is written (:84-95; :272-278 only warns).
(e) STF_DOCUMENT_FILE_TAGS (:133-149) is labelled 'recall' and lists 'study-report'. The repo's own golden fixture (qualification/golden-fixtures.ts:147), ectd-packager/types.ts:58, AnaToolDefinitions.ts:1349 and migrations/20261012_submission_leaf_stf_study_tagging.sql all use 'study-report-body', so the fixture's tag draws a warning.
(f) New blocker from 08b6c053a (2026-10-12). regional-packager.ts:926-948 refuses any FDA sequence with a Module 4/5 study-section leaf that lacks study_id or stf_file_tag. `npx tsx -e` on auditStfCoverage at HEAD returned errors STF_MISSING_STUDY_ID for 4.2.3.2 and 5.3.5.1, and none for 5.4. Nothing on the canonical placement path writes those columns: UpsertLeafInput (submission-service.ts:2363-2385) and upsertLeafSchema (routes/submissions.ts:192-212) have no such fields, the only insert (submission-service.ts:3169-3186) omits them, and a grep of client/src finds no input for them. Only AnA's package_ectd_for_region (AnaToolExecutor.ts:9227-9233) accepts them.
records.fixedBy: 6becd3fda (2026-10-05): server/services/ectd/stf-generator.ts:153-308 and server/services/submission-gateways/regional-packager.ts:1114-1186. 08b6c053a (2026-10-12): regional-packager.ts:916-948 (1789 coverage refusal), migrations/20261012_submission_leaf_stf_study_tagging.sql and core-to-packager.ts:203-208.
records.remaining: (1) The STF DOCTYPE path does not resolve from the study folder. (2) ich-stf-v2-2.dtd is not vendored, not bundled (missing from requiredDtdsForRegion) and never validated, not even by qualification. (3) The xlink namespace differs from the value the backbones use, and its correctness is unverified until the DTD is vendored. (4) The document file-tag list is recall: it contains 'study-report' where the repo elsewhere uses 'study-report-body', and a non-listed tag only warns. (5) No typed <category> elements are written. (6) There is no UI or API to record study_id or stf_file_tag on a placed leaf, so the 1789 gate refuses every FDA sequence that contains a Module 4/5 study report, at compile, freeze, dispatch and transmit.
records.severityRationale: An IND sequence 0000 normally carries Module 4 nonclinical study reports, and often Module 5 reports. At HEAD such a sequence cannot be compiled, frozen, dispatched or transmitted from the Submission Center, because nothing in the UI can satisfy the 1789 refusal. Even once tags can be recorded, the STF still cannot be resolved against its DTD, and FDA rejects invalid STFs. The core pilot filing journey fails.
records.acceptance:
1. Failing first: the new route test shows FDA-TRC-1789 for a 5.3.5.1 leaf placed without a study id or file-tag. After the change, the same leaf placed with studyId 'STUDY-101' and a sourced tag compiles in eCTD Compile and produces m5/.../stf-study-101.xml.
2. The placement dialog requires both fields for sections where requiresStfReference is true, and does not show them for 4.3, 5.2, 5.3.6 and 5.4.
3. Failing first: `xmllint --valid` on the golden STF fails at HEAD ('no DTD found') and passes after, using the bundled util/dtd/ich-stf-v2-2.dtd.
4. The STF's xmlns:xlink equals the DTD's #FIXED value.
5. The golden fixture's tag no longer produces a warning, and a tag outside the sourced list is refused for FDA.
6. `npm run qualify:ectd` shows an 'xmllint DTD' row for each STF.
records.dependencies: Steps 2-4 have no dependency and unblock human testing. Steps 5-9 depend on CAT2-01 (vendored ich-stf-v2-2.dtd, the tag and category valid-values, and the DTD-validation hook). Shares the leaf-metadata plumbing with CAT2-03.
